Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: joe/karen monte <jm3663@comcast.net>
Sent: Friday, September 11, 2015 2:23 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Dave Ausmus 
 
I don't believe that you can  "buy" a pennant, much less a World Series. look at the Big spenders like the Yankees, for example. How many series have they won lately?
Losing Scherzer,  getting rid of Soria, Cespedes, Porcello, Foster, to name a few, certainly didn't help. In addition to a weak farm system - has left the Tigers in a mess.
Trying to get in a World Series because of the elder Illitch's age set the Tigers back.
I've followed the Tigers for over 65 years.
